assets.prompt: A single original minimalist toy ball launcher turret for a friendly running defense mobile game. Squat rounded teal base, one thick cream barrel angled slightly upward pointing right, big golden ball visible at the muzzle, two chunky simple feet. Very simple silhouette, three large color areas, smooth matte plastic, almost no surface detail, no screws, no text, no logo, no scenery, no platform. Easily readable as a small 64 pixel game icon. Whole object isolated, game ready prop.
